title: REVISION SKINCARE: 30s vertical skincare commercial (Kling 4.0)
prompt_text: Create a video ad from image1, image2 30-second vertical 9:16 premium skincare commercial for brand name REVISION SKINCARE – SOOTHING FACIAL RINSE. Use the provided female portrait as strict identity authority: one actress only, same warm brown skin, long straight black hair, almond eyes, glossy lips, gold hoop earrings, elegant smile, slim build, and consistent face across all four versions. Use the provided bottle image as strict packaging authority for shape only: opaque glossy black bottle, rounded rectangular body, sloping shoulders, short black neck, large cylindrical ribbed black screw cap, original silver-bordered label. Preserve exact bottle geometry, proportions, cap and packaging. The reference video controls only pacing, bathroom setting, ad grammar, and final group tableau. Do not copy its original brand, exact wording, or layout. Core idea: one woman in a bright pink bathroom moves through four skincare moments - refreshing skin after cleansing, removing remaining impurities, soothing and refreshing the complexion, and completing her everyday toner routine - then ends with a polished product hero shot and a four-version finale, all played by the same face with different styling. Overall visual: a single pink bathroom set with glossy tiles, white counter, round mirror, soft blinds, and high-key diffused beauty light. Clean, bright, soft, slightly glossy, with subtle film grain and minimal camera movement. Use mostly static shots with tiny push-ins, neat product inserts, and one water-bubble hero shot. Music: light airy pop with soft whooshes, cotton-pad swipes, and faint water shimmer. No random readable text. The only brand text is brand name. 0.0-2.8s: Intro. Persona 1 appears in sporty mint/teal activewear, hair clipped back, minimal makeup. She tidies her hair, turns to camera, and says softly: "My skin deserves a gentle refresh." Keep the bathroom calm, pink, and bright. 2.8-5.6s: Product reveal. The bottle slides into center on the counter, front-on then at a slight 3/4 angle. Show the opaque glossy black bottle, rounded rectangular body, ribbed black screw cap, original silver-bordered label, and clean brand name. Hold the shot steady and elegant. 5.6-8.4s: Persona 2 appears in evening-glam styling, a black satin or off-shoulder top with slightly stronger eye makeup. She applies the toner to a cotton pad and gently wipes her face, then looks back with relief and says: "A refreshing finish, without the harsh feel." 8.4-11.2s: Persona 3 appears in a white robe, with naturally fresh skin and soft natural makeup. She gently pats her cheek after applying the toner and says: "My skin feels calm and refreshed." 11.2-14.0s: Persona 4 appears in a soft pink towel wrap or cream lounge top, very natural makeup, serene smile. She makes one final gentle application with a cotton pad and says: "A gentle step in my everyday routine." 14.0-16.8s: Quick matched cuts show the same actress as all four versions inside the same pink bathroom. Keep the face identical across looks, only wardrobe and makeup changing. Use bold white uppercase overlays: "ALCOHOL-FREE TONER", "GENTLE DAILY REFRESH", "SOOTHING SKINCARE", "FOR ALL SKIN TYPES". The bottle stays on the counter as the visual anchor. 16.8-22.6s: Water-bubble hero shot. The REVISION SKINCARE Soothing Facial Rinse bottle becomes the central object inside a glossy clear water sphere with tiny ripples and reflections. Keep the bottle pristine, upright, legible, and unwarped. Preserve the original black packaging and silver-bordered label. 22.6-30.0s: Final group tableau. All four versions of the same woman stand together in the pink bathroom, smiling calmly around the product on the counter. End on a clean premium packshot with the black bottle foregrounded and a minimal end card: "REVISION SKINCARE – SOOTHING FACIAL RINSE" and "Alcohol-free toner for all skin types." Hold steady for the final beat. Continuity rules: same face across all four looks, no face drift, same pink bathroom throughout, no change to bottle geometry, original black cap and label preserved, no extra brand names, no pink bottle, no pump dispenser, no black dramatic lighting, no clutter, no realism-breaking skin retouching, no excessive camera motion, no product redesign. Negative prompt: other brands, wrong packaging, micellar cleansing water wording, body oil wording, extra bottle shapes, pump dispenser, screw cap removed, cap missing, random text, messy bathroom, dark moody lighting, overblown sparkle, cartoon style, broken hands, warped fingers, label errors, duplicated unwanted characters.

title: Cheesy Baked Potatoes: 10s cinematic food commercial
prompt_text: Create a 10-second ultra-realistic cinematic food commercial in a warm, aesthetic home kitchen. Scene 1 (0–2s): Close-up of a small golden potato placed on a baking tray. A gloved hand gently holds it while a sharp knife cuts it into neat pieces. Scene 2 (2–4s): Show the potato pieces arranged beautifully on a small baking dish, topped generously with shredded mozzarella cheese and herbs. Scene 3 (4–6s): The dish slides into a compact oven. Show the cheese melting and bubbling under warm golden light. Scene 4 (6–8s): The oven opens, revealing perfectly baked golden potatoes covered in melted cheese with slightly crispy edges. Scene 5 (8–10s): Final hero shot of cheesy baked potatoes on a white ceramic plate, garnished with fresh parsley and cherry tomatoes. A fork lifts one piece, revealing stretchy melted mozzarella cheese. Style: Photorealistic food cinematography, macro close-ups, warm natural sunlight, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movements, appetizing textures, professional food advertisement, 4K quality, vertical 9:16. No text, no subtitles, no watermark, no distorted hands.

title: Korean cafe coffee flood: 30s live-action (Seedance 2.5)
prompt_text:
Video Prompt

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic live-action video set inside a stylish modern Korean coffee shop. Warm wooden interiors, large glass windows, natural sunlight, cozy café atmosphere, and several customers sitting at tables. Scene 1 (0–5 seconds): A young red-haired woman wearing a black oversized blazer and white shirt stands at the café counter holding a clear glass of coffee. A young female barista wearing a white shirt and dark green apron stands behind the counter. The red-haired woman takes a sip of her drink, while another young woman sitting nearby watches with a surprised expression. Scene 2 (5–10 seconds): A stylish young woman in a dark school-style outfit sits at a wooden café table with a beautifully prepared latte. Show a close-up of her face as she tastes the coffee, followed by a detailed close-up of the creamy latte art in her cup. Scene 3 (10–15 seconds): Suddenly, an enormous stream of dark brown coffee violently erupts inside the café, splashing across the wooden floor. Coffee spreads rapidly throughout the shop, creating a dramatic wave of liquid. Customers react with shock and confusion. Scene 4 (15–20 seconds): The red-haired woman and the other customers struggle to react as the coffee flood spreads around their feet. The red-haired woman looks overwhelmed, covering her face with her hands in disbelief. Show dynamic cinematic camera movements and realistic liquid physics. Scene 5 (20–26 seconds): The coffee wave becomes even more chaotic. A huge amount of coffee splashes through the café, knocking chairs and disturbing the peaceful atmosphere. The red-haired woman bends forward, trying to recover while coffee continues flowing around her. Scene 6 (26–30 seconds): The scene ends with a cinematic wide shot of the café counter, the barista watching the unbelievable disaster, and two beautifully presented coffee drinks on a wooden table: one iced coffee and one hot latte with perfect latte art. Visual Style: Ultra-realistic Korean cinematic drama aesthetic, photorealistic characters, natural facial expressions, detailed coffee splashes, realistic fluid simulation, dynamic camera angles, smooth transitions, warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, 4K quality, vertical 9:16 format. Important: Maintain consistent character appearances, realistic human movements, accurate object physics, and continuous scene progression. No cartoon effects or artificial-looking animation.

title: Tiny Chef, Giant Street: mixed-reality 2D girl (Seedance 2.5)
prompt_text: Create a whimsical mixed-reality animation featuring a miniature hand-drawn 2D girl with curly black hair, a yellow apron, red sneakers, and a tiny wooden spoon exploring a gigantic photorealistic city street. She encounters a giant pedestrian crossing where passing cars nearly blow her away, climbs a massive bus tire before sliding down, discovers a street food cart where she escapes a rolling sausage, sails across a giant puddle using a bottle cap as a boat, and flies through the air using a plastic shopping bag as a parachute. Finally, she celebrates on top of a giant burger until a human hand suddenly picks it up, leaving her frozen in disbelief. Combine expressive 2D animation with realistic urban environments, exaggerated scale, playful physics, cinematic macro close-ups, smooth camera movements, and seamless mixed-media compositing. Include realistic city ambience, traffic, footsteps, bus engines, sizzling food, water splashes, and playful comedic sound effects. No dialogue. Ultra-detailed visuals, consistent character design, cinematic depth of field, and high-end commercial animation quality.
